stories.title: Les Etats-Unis imposent des sanctions contre la Cour pénale internationale

en.title: The United States imposes sanctions against the International Criminal Court
en.summary: The Trump administration has escalated sanctions against the International Criminal Court by threatening companies that work with the institution, potentially disrupting its operations significantly.

stories.title: Navi Pillay prix Nobel de la paix 2026 : paix et droit international à l'honneur

en.title: Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize 2026: peace and international law honored
en.summary: Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, recognizing contributions to peace and international law.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix est décerné à la Sud-Africaine Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "pour ses efforts en faveur de la promotion de la paix et du droit international"

en.title: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to South African Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "for her efforts in promoting peace and international law"
en.summary: The 85-year-old Navanethem Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work on peace and international law. She chaired a UN independent inquiry that accused Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Prix Nobel de la paix : Navi Pillay saluée par la communauté internationale, Israël fait un parallèle avec les nazis

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize: Navi Pillay welcomed by international community, Israel draws Nazi parallel
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African legal expert received widespread international praise for her Nobel Peace Prize on October 9, though Israel objected to her leadership of an inquiry that characterized the Gaza conflict as genocide.

stories.title: Nobel de la paix décerné à Navi Pillay : oui aux droits humains

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay: yes to human rights
en.summary: Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize, an honor affirming the importance of human rights advocacy.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella aurait effacé les données d'un compte Facebook après les révélations de Mediapart

en.title: Jordan Bardella allegedly deleted Facebook account data after Mediapart revelations
en.summary: Jordan Bardella reportedly erased data from an old activist Facebook account following Mediapart's disclosure of antisemitic writings from his youth, which he denies authoring. The National Rally party has denied these allegations.

stories.title: Nobel de la Paix attribué à Navi Pillay : Israël estime que ce prix légitime «la haine et les préjugés» contre l’État hébreu

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay: Israel says award legitimizes "hatred and prejudices" against Jewish state
en.summary: Israel criticized the Nobel Peace Prize being awarded to Navi Pillay, former International Criminal Court president. The ICC president praised the prize's significance amid pressures on international justice institutions.

stories.title: South African former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: South African former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a South African judge who led the Rwanda genocide tribunal and headed a UN commission accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza, received the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: «Si vous applaudissez un peu plus fort, je partagerai peut-être le prix avec Trump », s’amuse Navanethem Pillay, Nobel de la paix 2026

en.title: "If you applaud a bit louder, I might share the prize with Trump," jokes Navanethem Pillay, 2024 Nobel Peace laureate
en.summary: South African jurist Navanethem Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize on October 9 for her efforts promoting peace and international law, making a lighthearted remark during the ceremony.

stories.title: L’avocate sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay reçoit le prix Nobel de la paix : «Si vous applaudissez un peu plus fort, je partagerai peut-être le prix avec Trump»

en.title: South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay receives Nobel Peace Prize: "If you applaud a little louder, I might share the prize with Trump"
en.summary: The Oslo committee recognized South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay with the Nobel Peace Prize, highlighting her exceptional courage and ethics as a former anti-apartheid activist. The U.S. president did not receive the award.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix 2026 décerné à la juriste sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay

en.title: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African jurist Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African jurist Navanethem Pillay received the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. She previously headed an independent UN inquiry commission that accused Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix décerné à l’avocate sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay, à l’heure où la justice est « attaquée »

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay at a time when justice is "under attack"
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize. She previously served as a judge, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, and president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda.

stories.title: Retraites, donation, PTZ « parentalité » : ce qu'ont voté les députés en commission pour le budget 2027

en.title: Pensions, donations, PTZ "parenthood": what lawmakers voted for in committee for the 2027 budget
en.summary: French parliament's finance commission began examining the 2027 financial bill on Wednesday, October 7, with votes on provisions regarding pensions, donations, and housing-related measures.

stories.title: OPINION. « Ni le RN, ni la technocratie : redonnons le pouvoir aux habitants des villes Sous-préfectures et aux territoires ruraux », par Fabien Verdier

en.title: OPINION. "Neither the RN nor technocracy: let's give power back to residents of sub-prefecture cities and rural territories," by Fabien Verdier
en.summary: Fabien Verdier argues for redistributing political power to local territories and rural areas as a response to the rise of the National Rally and excessive political centralization.

stories.title: Tout en montant en cadence, Embraer livre son premier E195-E2 à Latam Airlines

en.title: Embraer delivers first E195-E2 to Latam Airlines while ramping up production
en.summary: Latam Airlines received its first E195-E2 aircraft from Embraer on October 8, with 11 additional aircraft expected as Embraer increases production capacity.

en.title: Avolon orders 110 aircraft from Airbus
en.summary: Airbus received an order for 35 A330-900 and 75 A320neo aircraft from leasing company Avolon on October 9, demonstrating continued confidence in the European manufacturer.

stories.title: Chine-UE : un accord pour freiner les exportations de voitures hybrides

en.title: China-EU reach agreement to curb hybrid vehicle exports
en.summary: After two days of negotiations in Beijing, China and the European Union agreed to reduce Chinese hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicle exports to Europe by more than half.
